findings.text: _run_directory_control_log offers every file in the run directory to the control test, and both stream.jsonl and classification.json in a real run directory parse as pytest-format logs (measured on the reviewed run's own directory), so a transcript of an in-session red run, which is not a log of the declared mutation, can be admitted as the control; restricting candidates to capture-shaped files such as *.log would close it.

The recorded suite arms measure only the write-scope test files, not the test files that import the modified module, which the done-when names; I ran tests/test_control_gate_checks_facts.py, tests/test_control_is_compared_with_the_head_arm.py, tests/test_a_negative_control_is_read_from_the_runner.py and tests/test_every_failure_comparison_shares_one_rule.py at the head and got 55 passed, but the manifest carries no arm recording that and no base-revision comparison for them.
